messages:
maya: Heads-up: finalizing release notes for tonight's deploy (change window 23:00-00:30 PT). Draft ready under /docs/releases/v2.4.1. Need ops and comms eyeballs. Pin: service v2.4.1-rc3 -> v2.4.1.

deploy-bot: schedule requested: 2026-03-23T23:00PT for v2.4.1, canary 10% first 10m. Runbook: https://runbook/release/1766666666 

sasha: Oncall standby. What are rollback criteria? cpu/errors/latency thresholds?

tom: Propose rollback if 5xx rate >0.8% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increases >200ms vs baseline.

ryan: I'm cleaning rn copy. For internal Slack snippet: 'Deploying v2.4.1: perf fixes & quota improvements. Ops standby 23:00 PT.' Want a short and a long blurb?

jen: I'll ping comms to check long blurb. Also add audience split: ops-only channel + company-internal digest at 23:05.

sasha: Canary playbook: run helm upgrade with --set canary.weight=10 then watch metrics: `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/realtime`. Attaching quick checklist next.

sasha: Checklist: 1) DB migrations none 2) Pin config: feature.flag.quota=true 3) Warmups: redis cache primed 4) fallback: route to v2.3.9 image tag

deploy-bot: canary started at 23:00: proceeding to 10% (pods: 2/2). Metrics feed: https://metrics/alerts/1766666666

maya: Copy suggestion for ops-only: 'Starting canary for v2.4.1; monitor errors/latency; rollback @thresholds.' For all-hands version: 'small perf & quota update; no user-facing schema changes.'

tom: LGTM for rollback thresholds. Quick reminder: pin traffic split in traffic-router config to 100% only after 30m stable canary.

ryan: Comms approved long blurb. I'll post on #release-notes at 23:05. Can someone add the deploy link to the post?

jen: Will do. Also prepping a short troubleshooting note in the doc: 'If DB error spikes, run rollback: `kubectl set image deployment/realtime realtime=myorg/realtime:v2.3.9` and alert oncall.'

sasha: If anything looks flaky during canary, I'll trigger immediate rollback and notify #eng-oncall and #prod-ops.

deploy-bot: canary stabilized at 23:12 | metrics within thresholds. Ready for ramp to 100% in 10m per plan. Command to ramp: `deploy-bot ramp --to 100 --id 1766666666`

maya: Final call: anyone needs more time to review? If no objections I'll hit ramp at 23:22.

tom: No objections from infra. Go ahead.

ryan: Posting the internal announce now. @jen will add link.

jen: Posted. short blurb pinned in #release-notes. Added link to runbook and status page.

deploy-bot: ramp executed at 23:22 -> 100%. Final status: success. If rollback needed run: `deploy-bot rollback --id 1766666666`
